The Research Associate, Biomarker Operations supports the execution of biomarker and biospecimen activities across oncology clinical trials, with a particular focus on Multiple Myeloma and hematologic malignancies. This role partners closely with Translational Medicine, Clinical Operations, study teams, and external laboratory partners to coordinate sample collection, tracking, shipment, testing, and data reconciliation activities. The successful candidate will help ensure high-quality biomarker operations throughout the clinical trial lifecycle by managing biospecimen workflows, supporting vendor relationships, maintaining study documentation, and contributing to study startup and execution activities.

The individual will also leverage AI-enabled tools, automation, and data-driven technologies to streamline workflows, enhance operational efficiency, improve reporting and sample oversight, and support data-driven decision-making. The ideal candidate has experience in oncology clinical research, strong organizational and project coordination skills, digital and AI fluency, and a passion for advancing translational science through operational excellence, innovation, and continuous improvement.

The Research Associate, Biomarker Operations supports the execution of biomarker and biospecimen activities across global oncology clinical trials, with a primary focus on Multiple Myeloma and hematologic malignancies. This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an MDM Subject Matter Expert based in San Francisco Bay Area.

MDM Architecture and Design Assurance: Provide expert oversight of MDM architecture, entity models, identity-resolution strategies, golden records, hierarchies, relationships, and stewardship processes.
Matching and Survivorship Rules: Review and validate matching strategies, duplicate identification, confidence scoring, survivorship logic, source precedence, merge and unmerge procedures, and exception-management rules.

Milestone and Deliverable Reviews: Assess solution designs, configurations, data pipelines, data-quality controls, and deployment deliverables to ensure alignment with approved requirements and MDM best practices.

Platform and Solution Assessment: Evaluate commercial MDM platforms and custom-built solutions, considering total cost of ownership, licensing, customization requirements, upgrade implications, and internal support capabilities.
Auditability and Explainability: Promote transparent and reversible mastering practices, ensuring matching and survivorship decisions can be traced to source records and supported by comprehensive audit histories.
Documentation and Knowledge Transfer: Contribute to knowledge-transfer materials, rule catalogs, stewardship procedures, and operating-model documentation that enable effective and sustainable business ownership.

Requirements

The ideal candidate brings extensive hands-on experience in enterprise MDM and data governance, along with the technical depth and advisory capabilities needed to influence complex implementation decisions. You should be comfortable working across business and technical teams, evaluating competing approaches, and translating intricate data-management challenges into practical solutions.

Professional Experience: 12+ years of experience in Master Data Management, Data Governance, Data Quality, or Enterprise Information Management, including senior advisory or design-assurance responsibilities.
MDM Expertise: Deep knowledge of entity resolution, deterministic and probabilistic matching, survivorship, hierarchy management, crosswalks, golden records, stewardship, and exception management.
Platform Experience: Practical experience with MDM platforms such as Profisee, Informatica MDM, Reltio, Ataccama, Stibo Systems, or comparable commercial solutions.
Master Data Domains: Strong understanding of customer, constituent, supporter, provider, supplier, product, or similar master-data domains, including the challenges of resolving identities across multiple systems.
Architecture and Implementation Reviews: Experience reviewing MDM architecture, platform configuration, data quality, governance, testing, and operational-readiness deliverables across complex implementations.
Advisory and Communication Skills: Strong stakeholder-management and consulting capabilities, with the ability to influence business and technical teams, challenge design assumptions constructively, and guide complex MDM decisions.
Analytical Problem-Solving: Ability to assess intricate data-management challenges, identify risks, and recommend practical solutions that balance technical requirements with business needs.

Opportunity to contribute to complex enterprise MDM initiatives and influence critical architecture and governance decisions.
Collaboration with multidisciplinary teams of architects, technical specialists, developers, business stakeholders, and data stewards.

Company Overview
At Skild AI, we are building the world's first general purpose robotic intelligence that is robust and adapts to unseen scenarios without failing. We believe massive scale through data-driven machine learning is the key to unlocking these capabilities for the widespread deployment of robots within society. Position Overview
Join Skild AI’s manufacturing team to help ensure robots, accessories, and incoming materials meet design requirements and quality standards. In this hands-on role, you will perform in-process and final inspections, verify incoming material conformity, and complete visual inspections of returned robots and accessories. You will document findings, identify nonconforming products, and work with manufacturing and engineering to resolve quality issues.
Responsibilities
Inspect incoming components, materials, and subassemblies against engineering drawings, specifications, approved samples, and applicable inspection criteria to verify design conformity and quality.
Perform in-line and in-process inspections at designated assembly checkpoints. Verify workmanship, component placement, hardware installation, cable routing, connector seating, labeling, and other defined acceptance criteria.
Complete final inspections of manufactured robots and accessories before release. Verify required inspection and test records are complete and products meet documented acceptance criteria.
Perform visual receiving inspections of all incoming return material authorization (RMA) robots and accessories. Document physical condition, visible damage, missing components, identification labels, and other observed discrepancies.
Record RMA inspection findings and photographs, as appropriate, and communicate observations to repair personnel. Distinguish observed conditions from suspected causes requiring further evaluation.
Use appropriate measuring instruments, inspection tools, and visual inspection methods to check dimensions, fit, finish, and assembly quality. Verify equipment calibration status before use.
Identify, label, and segregate nonconforming material or products according to established procedures. Document discrepancies and escalate issues for authorized disposition.
Maintain accurate inspection records, checklists, and quality data, including part numbers, serial numbers, inspection results, and supporting evidence as required.
Communicate recurring defects and quality trends to manufacturing, engineering, and quality personnel. Support root-cause investigations, corrective actions, and improvements to inspection processes.
Coordinate inspections with production and receiving priorities while maintaining consistent acceptance standards. Follow safety, material handling, and 5S practices and perform other assigned quality duties.

Preferred Qualifications
At least 5 years of experience in quality control, quality inspection, or a similar role supporting electro-mechanical manufacturing.
Experience performing incoming, in-process, and final inspections of mechanical parts, electrical components, or assembled products.
Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, dimensions, tolerances, specifications, bills of materials, and inspection instructions.
Hands-on experience using calipers, micrometers, and other inspection or measuring equipment appropriate to the product.
Ability to evaluate electro-mechanical assembly workmanship, including hardware installation, PCBA placement, cable routing, connector engagement, and labeling.
Strong attention to detail and sound judgment when comparing inspection results with documented acceptance criteria.
Experience documenting defects, maintaining traceable inspection records, and handling nonconforming material through established procedures.
Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to describe defects objectively and work effectively with production, receiving, repair, and engineering teams.
Ability to organize inspection priorities, work independently within defined procedures, and escalate unclear requirements or quality concerns.
Comfort using Google Docs, Google Sheets, email, and electronic quality or production systems to record and communicate inspection results.

Additional Experience We Value 
Experience inspecting robots, automated equipment, or similar complex electro-mechanical products.
Experience documenting the condition of RMA products and supporting repair or failure-analysis teams.
Familiarity with geometric dimensioning and tolerancing, sampling plans, and applicable workmanship standards.
Experience with ERP or product lifecycle management systems, such as Rootstock and Arena, and supporting corrective actions or continuous improvement.

Physical Requirements 
The role involves regular sitting, standing, and walking in a manufacturing environment, as well as close visual inspection and hands-on use of inspection tools. Handling components and accessing inspection points on robots and accessories may require bending and reaching. Essential job functions may be performed with or without reasonable accommodation.

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an MDM Subject Matter Expert based in San Francisco Bay Area.

We are seeking an experienced Master Data Management (MDM) Subject Matter Expert to provide strategic guidance and senior-level design assurance across complex enterprise data initiatives. In this role, you will help shape reliable identity-resolution strategies, golden-record models, matching rules, and data governance practices. You will collaborate with architects, technical leads, developers, business owners, and data stewards to validate critical decisions and ensure implementation quality. Your expertise will be essential in resolving complex data challenges and aligning technical solutions with business objectives. You will also help establish sustainable stewardship processes and operating models that support long-term data quality, accountability, and operational excellence.

Accountabilities

As a senior MDM advisor, you will oversee key design decisions, assess implementation deliverables, and guide teams toward scalable, transparent, and sustainable master data solutions.

MDM Architecture and Design Assurance: Provide expert oversight of MDM architecture, entity models, identity-resolution strategies, golden records, hierarchies, relationships, and stewardship processes.
Matching and Survivorship Rules: Review and validate matching strategies, duplicate identification, confidence scoring, survivorship logic, source precedence, merge and unmerge procedures, and exception-management rules.
Data Governance and Stewardship: Advise business owners and data stewards on critical data elements, ownership models, governance decision rights, stewardship thresholds, and exception-resolution processes.
Milestone and Deliverable Reviews: Assess solution designs, configurations, data pipelines, data-quality controls, and deployment deliverables to ensure alignment with approved requirements and MDM best practices.
Complex Issue Resolution: Support teams in addressing challenging issues involving matching, data quality, lineage, persistent identifiers, scalability, and stewardship throughout design, development, testing, and deployment.
Platform and Solution Assessment: Evaluate commercial MDM platforms and custom-built solutions, considering total cost of ownership, licensing, customization requirements, upgrade implications, and internal support capabilities.
Auditability and Explainability: Promote transparent and reversible mastering practices, ensuring matching and survivorship decisions can be traced to source records and supported by comprehensive audit histories.
Documentation and Knowledge Transfer: Contribute to knowledge-transfer materials, rule catalogs, stewardship procedures, and operating-model documentation that enable effective and sustainable business ownership.

Requirements

The ideal candidate brings extensive hands-on experience in enterprise MDM and data governance, along with the technical depth and advisory capabilities needed to influence complex implementation decisions. You should be comfortable working across business and technical teams, evaluating competing approaches, and translating intricate data-management challenges into practical solutions.

Professional Experience: 12+ years of experience in Master Data Management, Data Governance, Data Quality, or Enterprise Information Management, including senior advisory or design-assurance responsibilities.
MDM Expertise: Deep knowledge of entity resolution, deterministic and probabilistic matching, survivorship, hierarchy management, crosswalks, golden records, stewardship, and exception management.
Platform Experience: Practical experience with MDM platforms such as Profisee, Informatica MDM, Reltio, Ataccama, Stibo Systems, or comparable commercial solutions.
Master Data Domains: Strong understanding of customer, constituent, supporter, provider, supplier, product, or similar master-data domains, including the challenges of resolving identities across multiple systems.
Architecture and Implementation Reviews: Experience reviewing MDM architecture, platform configuration, data quality, governance, testing, and operational-readiness deliverables across complex implementations.
Advisory and Communication Skills: Strong stakeholder-management and consulting capabilities, with the ability to influence business and technical teams, challenge design assumptions constructively, and guide complex MDM decisions.
Analytical Problem-Solving: Ability to assess intricate data-management challenges, identify risks, and recommend practical solutions that balance technical requirements with business needs.

Full-time employment opportunity.
Opportunity to contribute to complex enterprise MDM initiatives and influence critical architecture and governance decisions.
Collaboration with multidisciplinary teams of architects, technical specialists, developers, business stakeholders, and data stewards.

Identify, label, and segregate nonconforming material or products according to established procedures. Document discrepancies and escalate issues for authorized disposition.
Maintain accurate inspection records, checklists, and quality data, including part numbers, serial numbers, inspection results, and supporting evidence as required.
Communicate recurring defects and quality trends to manufacturing, engineering, and quality personnel. Support root-cause investigations, corrective actions, and improvements to inspection processes.

Experience performing incoming, in-process, and final inspections of mechanical parts, electrical components, or assembled products.

Comfort using Google Docs, Google Sheets, email, and electronic quality or production systems to record and communicate inspection results.

Experience inspecting robots, automated equipment, or similar complex electro-mechanical products.
Experience documenting the condition of RMA products and supporting repair or failure-analysis teams.
Familiarity with geometric dimensioning and tolerancing, sampling plans, and applicable workmanship standards.
Experience with ERP or product lifecycle management systems, such as Rootstock and Arena, and supporting corrective actions or continuous improvement.
